name: Delivery-Only Matcha Shop in Bangkok
business_problem: Should we launch a delivery-only matcha shop in Bangkok focused on premium drinks and light snacks?
target_customers: Urban office workers, university students, health-conscious consumers, and cafe delivery users aged 18-35
constraints: Delivery-only model; no dine-in store; must validate demand within 90 days; budget must cover equipment, ingredients, packaging, marketing, platform fees, and initial working capital
expected_output: A go/no-go recommendation with pilot plan, unit economics, break-even assumptions, and key risks

name: Increase Insurance Revenue from Mobile App Funnel
business_problem: How can we increase insurance revenue generated from the mobile app funnel without hurting user experience or policy quality?
budget: 3,000,000 THB for experimentation, analytics, and funnel improvements
target_customers: Existing mobile app users who are eligible for motor, health, travel, or personal accident insurance offers
constraints: Must comply with insurance sales regulations; limited engineering capacity; no aggressive dark patterns; improvements should be testable within one quarter
expected_output: A prioritized growth plan with funnel diagnostics, revenue assumptions, experiment roadmap, and expected financial impact

name: AI Quality Control for Telesales Calls
business_problem: Should we launch an AI quality control system that reviews telesales calls for compliance, sales quality, and coaching opportunities?
budget: 2,500,000 THB for MVP build, model evaluation, integration, and pilot operations
target_customers: Insurance, banking, telecom, and consumer finance telesales teams with high call volumes and compliance risk
constraints: Must protect customer privacy; Thai language call transcription quality may vary; pilot must integrate with existing call recording systems; management needs measurable QA productivity gains
expected_output: A launch recommendation with target segment, MVP scope, financial assumptions, implementation risks, and pilot success criteria

name: Customer Segmentation for Car Insurance Renewal
business_problem: How can we improve customer segmentation to increase car insurance renewal rates and reduce discount leakage?
budget: 1,500,000 THB for data preparation, modeling, campaign design, and testing
target_customers: Existing car insurance policyholders approaching renewal within the next 90 days
constraints: Must use available customer, policy, claim, and interaction data; renewal campaigns must be operationally simple for agents; avoid unfair or non-compliant pricing treatment
expected_output: A segmentation strategy with priority segments, renewal interventions, expected uplift, data requirements, and test design

name: Data Analytics Service for SMEs
business_problem: Should we build a data analytics service for SMEs that turns sales, marketing, and operations data into dashboards and decision support?
budget: 4,000,000 THB for product development, initial hiring, sales pilots, and customer onboarding
geography: Thailand and Southeast Asia pilot markets
target_customers: SMEs with 20-300 employees that use POS, ecommerce, CRM, or accounting systems but lack internal analytics teams
constraints: Must reach product-market validation within six months; limited brand awareness; integration scope must stay narrow for MVP; pricing must be affordable for SMEs
expected_output: A market entry recommendation with target niche, service package, pricing assumptions, delivery model, and break-even logic
